data.narrative:
Atlas Motion is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Christian Mochen (ex-Shield AI), Tom Baron (ex-Mach Industries), and Carlo Dela Rosa (ex-Shield AI), which has raised $11.5M to date. The valuation universe comprises one public comparable and eight private peers in Robotics & Manufacturing, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics.

Only one valuation method was applicable given data constraints. Stage-progression analysis, anchored to the $11.5M raised as a proxy for current implied value, applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $29M. A peer-median approach was not viable; while eleven same-sector peers exist, narrowing to stage-aligned or valuation-tier-matched comparables produced insufficient datapoints (fewer than three required), making sector-wide medians insufficiently precise.

The triangulated range is $24M–$33M, with a median of $29M. This analysis reflects a single methodology and thus carries material uncertainty around stage-typical step-up rates and whether Atlas Motion's capital efficiency and founder pedigree merit premium or discount positioning within that range. Resolution of valuation will depend on near-term milestone achievement, customer traction, and competitive positioning relative to the identified peer set.
